title: My VPN keeps dropping, what should I check?
latency_basis: the gap before each call's llm_call event in the original recording

input.message: vpn has been dropping every 10-15 min all morning, i'm on wifi at home. anything obvious i should check before this turns into a ticket

calls.output: {"category":"answerable","rationale":"The handbook's self-serve VPN troubleshooting steps directly address frequent disconnects on Wi-Fi: switch to a wired connection and confirm the network isn't a captive-portal type that blocks VPN traffic. No ticket is needed yet since the requester is asking what to check before filing one.","confidence":0.9}

{"answer":"Before filing a ticket, try the self-serve steps for frequent VPN disconnects: switch from Wi-Fi to a wired connection if you have one available at home, and confirm your home network isn't a captive-portal-style network (this mainly applies to hotel/airport Wi-Fi blocking VPN traffic, so likely not the cause on home Wi-Fi, but worth ruling out). If disconnects come with a 'certificate not trusted' error, check whether your device clock is more than 5 minutes out of sync, since that's a common cause alongside an expired certificate. If switching to wired and confirming these don't resolve it, go ahead and open a ticket — the handbook's self-serve list for this issue doesn't cover cases where wired isn't an option or the above checks don't help, so I can't say confidently what else to try beyond that.","cited_chunk_ids":["sec-4"]}
